subject: Edge-serving headcount tradeoff & one-time comp-band request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Edge-serving headcount tradeoff & one-time comp-band request

Team —

Short version: Acme Retail just moved a high-priority edge contract into closable status if we can commit to an additional dedicated edge runtime engineer in November. We have one unfilled Runtime Infra FTE in the hiring slate that could be repurposed — request permission to reallocate that slot to "Edge-serving Senior Runtime Engineer" (L6) and approve a one-time comp-band uplift for this hire (candidate is market-facing, will lead the edge delivery).

Why this matters now:
- Acme has agreed to a pilot with committed spend that ramps quickly; their latency SLAs require on-device/edge-serving integration expertise.
- If we miss this window, the opportunity will shift to a competitor and Acme will push for a different vendor.

Asks:
1) Approve transfer of one currently budgeted Runtime Infra headcount to Edge-serving (internal role change).
2) Approve temporary comp-band exception to hire at L6 salary band for this slot (candidate expectations: $200–220k base + equity).
3) If approved, authorize Dylan to extend the formal offer after finance review.

Context & attachments: I asked Clara at TalentBridge to surface a candidate we interviewed last week (Jordan Smith) — experienced in serving at the edge, immediate start availability. I attached a comp blend and candidate profile for reference.

If I don’t hear objections by EOD today I’ll ask Dylan to prepare an offer packet to send tomorrow (Friday).

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Staff Engineering Manager, Platform Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Edge-serving headcount tradeoff & one-time comp-band request

Soojin —

Thanks for the heads-up; +1 to repurposing the slot. A few quick data points to support the ask (pulled from last quarter telemetry):
- Edge request backlog for customer-facing teams grew 38% QoQ.
- Our internal serving infra has ~3 urgent edge-related tickets that require runtime expertise (latency tail fixes, KV cache durability across flaky networks).

I agree the candidate profile looks strong. Caveat: moving to L6 for this slot will increase cost-per-FTE ~18% relative to the baseline band for the headcount we had budgeted. Attached comp-blend-20261021.xlsx shows options: we can cap base at $220k if we reduce equity by ~10–15% compared to a standard L6.

If leadership is okay with the one-time comp-band exception and the conditional finance cap, we should proceed — Jordan has the skillset to unblock the pilot quickly which likely offsets the cost through contracted revenue.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Clara Zhou <clara@talentbridge.co>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Candidate Jordan Smith — base expectations and availability

Dylan / Soojin —

Quick note from Jordan:
- Baseline expectation: $210k base; total comp flexibility if base is set at $200–220k with RSU grant alignment.
- Prefers an on-site ramp for the first two weeks but is comfortable with a remote-first start.
- Earliest start date: Nov 9, 2026.

I attached the candidate-profile-jordan-smith.pdf (resume, public work samples, references). Jordan is evaluating two other offers but has expressed a preference for Redwood’s stack and the edge work — they asked if we can move quickly on compensation.

Let me know when you want me to share the formal comps/benchmarks I collected.

—Clara
TalentBridge (recruiting partner)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Edge-serving headcount tradeoff & one-time comp-band request

Soojin / Marcus —

Appreciate the concise proposal. I have no strategic objections to shifting the slot given the near-term revenue opportunity. Two operational asks before I sign off:
1) Include a brief ramp plan and success metrics (30/60/90) for the hire tied to the Acme pilot.
2) Finance needs a conditional approval number and a headcount note for the capex/opex forecast. Markus, can you confirm we can absorb a one-time uplift to L6 at the numbers Marcus shared (cap base at $220k and tweak equity)?

If finance confirms, Kimberly signs off and we can move to offer.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
VP, Product & Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Finance decision: conditional approval for comp-band exception

Kimberly / team —

Reviewed: comp-blend-20261021.xlsx and the revenue commentary. Given the contracted pilot economics from Acme (projected $1.2M ARR if pilot converts) I approve a one-time comp-band exception for the Edge-serving hire with the following conditions:
- Base salary cap: $220,000
- Target total cash (base + bonus) must not exceed $235,000 in year one
- Equity allocation: reduce RSU grant by up to 15% relative to standard L6 grants per the comp blend
- Offer contingent on a 90-day success checkpoint tied to the Acme pilot milestones (finance will review at 90 days)

Dylan: you have finance signoff to extend the offer within the constraints above. Please add the 90-day checkpoint clause to the offer letter and return a final packaged offer for counters to finance.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@gmail.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T15:41:00-07:00
Subject: Offer: Senior Runtime Engineer, Edge-serving (Redwood Inference)

Jordan —

Excited to move forward. On behalf of Redwood, please find attached the formal offer packet: offer-letter-jordan-smith.docx. Highlights (per finance approval):
- Base: $220,000
- Target bonus: up to $15,000 (role-based, discretionary year 1)
- Equity: RSU grant (reduced per prior note; see attached schedule)
- Start date: proposed Nov 9, 2026 (flexible)
- 90-day success checkpoint tied to Acme pilot deliverables (documented in offer)

Next steps: if the terms look good please sign and return the attached offer. If you have compensation questions we can discuss quickly — we will try to be responsive given competing timelines.

Soojin / Marcus / Markus: this email is the formal offer send; attachment attached. I’ll loop Clara if we need to coordinate counter-offer timing.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Technical Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Attachment: offer-letter-jordan-smith.docx
